architecture.hexagonal: UI -> Tauri closed command -> M03 facade -> M04 input -> existing single S1; M04 -> C1/M05 output abstractions -> adapters

architecture.state_owner: M04 owns authoritative content/history/baselines; M03 derived immutable candidate/preview records only
architecture.transaction: validate native caller -> replay admission -> C1 immutable candidate -> verify generation/revision/unused -> M05 Candidate pin -> M04 one Edit -> M05 complete live/history transfer -> Applied or AppliedRetentionDeferred

contracts: C1 validated canonical raw/semantic candidate required; unsupported not installable; request cannot inject payload or proof
new request compares current owner generation, candidate capture generation/revision and expected revision; same request replay precedes used-candidate check after current authorization

only verified M04 commit advances revision/history once and consumes candidate; Redo invalidated; NoChange consumes candidate only after verified M04 NoChange record, no Edit/history/revision increment

NoChange exact candidate policy: verified M04 semantic-equal terminal record consumes candidate without Edit/revision/history/Redo changes; same request replays unchanged; new ID CandidateUsed. Requires Owner adoption and runtime contract tests.
proof failure after possible commit must be Indeterminate/UnverifiedOutcome, never ErrorUnchanged or automatic resubmit
AppliedRetentionDeferred is committed, pin Held, no rollback; same ID returns retained outcome, no transfer retry or commit
replay may deliver old R8 at live R9 but cannot render it or alter current state; close/revocation blocks disclosure
all negative precommit fixtures keep live/history/redo/candidate unchanged; retain flag means do not release any existing pin, not proof one was created

proof checker derives listed material relations but does not prove native issuer security, persistent receipts, provider implementation, concurrent ordering, or complete project inventory
state reducer assumes native caller and immutable request capture facts; runtime loss does not rebuild success from M05 pin
